caveats: Adkins v. Fields, E.D. Ky. 7:22-CV-7, filed Jan 31, 2022 by Sabrina Adkins (and Estate of Jennifer Hill, whose claims were dismissed as time-barred) against deputy/court security officer Ben Fields, the Letcher County Sheriff (official capacity), and Eastern Kentucky Correctional Services, alleging Fields coerced sex from women he supervised on home incarceration (threats over jail/ankle-monitor fees). Settled March 3, 2026 during jury selection; terms not disclosed, so amount is null. Fields pleaded guilty in state court to third-degree rape, third-degree sodomy, tampering with a prisoner monitoring device, and second-degree perjury (~6 months jail plus probation). Plaintiff was a supervisee, not an employee, hence 'civilian'. Then-sheriff Mickey Stines was deposed Sept 16, 2024 and days later shot Judge Kevin Mullins (separate murder case, not this lawsuit). Fox56 source returned 403.
